activation.activeBody: Checked offline: signature, key id, the studio entitlement and the expiry. Nothing leaves this machine.
activation.body: Paste a credential to unlock writing. The bundled community credential is used automatically when you have not activated one.
activation.brandLine: Four writers · one machine · manuscripts stay local
activation.fact.subject: Subject
activation.fail.title: When it fails, it says only these eight things
activation.failureTitle: When it fails, it says only these three things
activation.fallbackBody: Reason: {{reason}} Until you replace it, the bundled community credential keeps the studio running.
activation.fallbackInline: A credential you pasted is not in effect — the bundled community credential is being used instead. Open the credential panel to see why, or to replace it.
activation.footnote: A credential is not an account: no cloud, no sign-in, no password reset. A new machine gets a new credential from the author.
activation.hint: Paste the token you received. Verification runs on this machine, offline.
activation.honest: The check runs offline: the signature proves the credential was issued by us, not that the person holding it bought it. It gates this plugin's own tools only.
activation.intro: Paste the whole credential the author sent you. It starts with {{prefix}} and is checked here, offline, the moment you press Activate.
activation.keysNote: Offline verification proves the token was signed by us — not who is holding it.
activation.limitNote: The whole token goes in one box, up to 2,048 characters
activation.offlineNote: The studio does not go online and does not upload manuscripts; files stay in the local project folder.
activation.opens.move: Moving to another machine gets a freshly signed credential; the old one expires
activation.opens.team: Four writers, the chapters already landed, and the foreshadowing ledger
activation.opens.title: What opens up afterwards
activation.opens.workspace: One workspace, existing only on this machine
activation.point.keys: Signed with an Ed25519 key this build already trusts
activation.point.noAccount: No account and no machine fingerprint — the token carries neither
activation.point.offline: Not one network call, at any point
activation.quote: Stand the character up first, then let the plot run into him.
activation.quoteNote: Before activation this tab shows the credential state only: it does not fill the panel and does not pop a dialog.
activation.reason.entitlement: This credential does not include the studio entitlement.
activation.reason.malformed: That does not look like a Mahua Novels credential.
activation.reason.signature: The signature does not match the content.
activation.reason.unknownKey: The credential was signed with a key this build does not trust.
activation.reject.bad-public-key: Trusted public key does not decode
activation.reject.missing-entitlement: No studio entitlement in the claim
activation.reject.signature-mismatch: Signature does not match the claims
activation.reject.unknown-key-id: Key id is not in the trusted list
activation.rejectNote: Failures report their real code — there is no 'network error' fallback.
activation.rule.expiry: Thirty days before it expires, the credential chip turns into an open task
activation.rule.machine: A credential is checked by signature and expiry only: no account, no upload
activation.rule.offline: The signature is checked on this machine with the author's public key — nothing leaves it
